verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews pull in the incident lifecycle, Slack data, and the Scribe Agent to build chronological incident narratives. Scribe also transcribes incident calls and records key decisions and action items, which covers automatic capture of alerts, actions, and chat decisions. However, nothing in the evidence shows the timeline itself can be edited or annotated afterwards. Missing for 10: documented editing/annotation of timeline entries, explicit detail on the auto-captured alert/action timeline log, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
